You are given 20 mL of an unknown sample solution containing 5 different inorganic cations. If you run out of the sample, you cannot perform any tests that use it but you can keep experimenting with other solutions in the Inventory from the previously performed tests. NOTE: All solutions are at room temperature.

Comma-separated string of the cations present. Examples: 'K+, Sr+2, Al+3' or 'Li+, Hg2+2, Al+3, Ca+2, Cu+2'
